title: The Spend Window Behind Made-to-Order Deposit Reductions, Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
**Rule.** For Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order deposits, the customer's spend is the total of the payments captured on the customer's Marlowe & Finch orders over a window that depends on the membership:

- for a member enrolled 60 months or more: the payments of the last 24 months divided by 2, a yearly average;
- for a member enrolled fewer than 12 months: the payments since the month of enrolment;
- for every other customer: the payments of the last 12 months.

Membership means the customer's active Marlowe Rewards membership. Its months are counted from the enrolment date to today. The payments are those captured on the customer's Online Orders.

**Questions and answers**

*A member has been enrolled for 6 years. Which payments make up the spend?*
Those of the last 24 months, divided by 2. For example, $5000 captured over the last 24 months gives a spend of $2500.

*A member enrolled in May, and today is in October of the same year. Which payments count?*
The member is enrolled fewer than 12 months, so the payments since May count.

*A member enrolled 30 months ago?*
Neither 60 months or more nor fewer than 12, so the payments of the last 12 months count.

*Exactly 12 months, or exactly 60 months?*
At 12 months the member is no longer under 12, so the last 12 months apply. At 60 months the 24-month average applies.

| Months enrolled | 11 | 12 | 59 | 60 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spend window | Since the month of enrolment | Last 12 months | Last 12 months | Last 24 months divided by 2 |
